text: {"name":"ll_conn_tx_power_prepare","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Prepares a BLE connection's RF transmit channel and calibrated power settings, returning channel readiness when the TX control requests a check.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v2":"tx_control","v5":"conn_flags","v9":"rf_channel","v10":"tx_power_code","v11":"tx_control_word"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":27,"meaning":"Byte whose 0xff sentinel selects the default TX-power path"},{"offset":29,"meaning":"RF channel index used to select channel state and configure the radio"},{"offset":30,"meaning":"Connection state flags controlling TX and RF setup"},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Connection TX configuration flags controlling the TX-control enable byte"},{"offset":76,"meaning":"Pointer to the connection's TX-control block"},{"offset":0,"meaning":"TX-control block byte receiving the selected TX-power code"},{"offset":1,"meaning":"TX-control block enable/configuration byte"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"TX-control block status and configuration word"}]}
